text:
You suddenly notice billowing, scarlet clouds that consume the horizon.  Crimson and yellow lightning strikes and lingers a moment.  Next you notice the smell - like a freshly chlorinated pool, with the aftertaste of battery acid.  It doesn't seem safe to breathe.

Something is coming.

Dust and crimson mist roll across the sky.  Red and gold lightning splits the clouds, hanging and burning.  Next you notice the smell - like a freshly chlorinated pool, with the aftertaste of battery acid.  It doesn't seem safe to breathe.

Something is coming.

A wall of scarlet dust climbs out of the horizon, devouring the light.  Veins of crimson lightning fork through it, frozen for a tense breath.  Next you notice the smell - like a freshly chlorinated pool, with the aftertaste of battery acid.  It doesn't seem safe to breathe.

It's coming.

The horizon boils with churning, scarlet clouds, vast beyond reckoning.  Crimson lightning cracks, silently, frozen for too long to be right.  Next you notice the smell - like a freshly chlorinated pool, with the aftertaste of battery acid.  It doesn't seem safe to breathe.

Something draws near.

You catch it first from the corner of your eye: a colossal storm, blood-red, swallowing the sky.  Next you notice the smell - like a freshly chlorinated pool, with the aftertaste of battery acid.  It doesn't seem safe to breathe.

Something is out there.

A dense fog spills over the horizon like an open wound.  It almost seems to fall from normal storm clouds like a perverse waterfall.  Next you notice the smell - like a freshly chlorinated pool, with the aftertaste of battery acid.  It doesn't seem safe to breathe.

Lightning, first gold, then crimson, forks across the sky.  Something is coming.

You notice an enormous stain upon the sky - a churning scarlet cloud, swallowing everything.  Next you notice the smell - like a freshly chlorinated pool, with the aftertaste of battery acid.  It doesn't seem safe to breathe.

It's coming.

At first it looks like smoke, then a storm cloud - scarlet fog, billowing and churning, and backed by crooked, yellow lightning.  Like a screaming face it vomits itself upon the horizon.  Next you notice the smell - like a freshly chlorinated pool, with the aftertaste of battery acid.  It doesn't seem safe to breathe.

It's coming.

You notice the horizon vanish into scarlet fog.  Crimson and gold shatter the sky as a bolt of lightning crosses it, grasping at the clear skies surrounding the storm.  Next you notice the smell - like a freshly chlorinated pool, with the aftertaste of battery acid.  It doesn't seem safe to breathe.

It's coming.  Slowly.  But surely.

The sky before you is consumed, replaced by a churning wall of scarlet storm clouds.  Lightning flashes several times.  It lingers for too long.  Too still.  Too easy.  Too silent.  Next you notice the smell - like a freshly chlorinated pool, with the aftertaste of battery acid.  It doesn't seem safe to breathe.

Something is out there.  Something is coming.
